content:
I saved the decision to the project's shared memory store, EngramDB, so later sessions and your collaborators will see it, not just me. It says: new or changed public API routes go under `/v2`, and `/v1` is frozen (no new endpoints, no changes to behavior or response shapes).

I searched the repo for existing `/v1` or `/v2` paths. Neither match is one of our routes:
- `tests/test_payments.py:4` points at an external payments sandbox (`.../v1/charges`).
- `src/billing/invoices.py:8` is `LEDGER_URL`, which points at an internal ledger service (`.../v1/postings`).

The memory notes that URLs like these are out of scope, so they shouldn't be renamed to `/v2`. I found no routes of our own under either version yet.
